title: Execute alias-safe joint row-Scale32 tensor-codebook W4 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after two-build identity, V3-relative model-only improvement, the same 8/8 non-evaluator exact-sequence gate, all 312 Dynamic Scale32 events, and every bound hash pass verification.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated V4 runner that freshly reconstructs the verified alias-safe model split and grouped Dynamic Scale32 activation policy, then jointly optimizes the existing per-output-row Scale32 records and one 16-entry signed-Q4.4 tensor codebook while retaining one 4-bit index per weight and no additional metadata.

required_constructor.source: pinned BF16 weights only; no prompt, output, token, or gate data
required_constructor.initialization: fresh V3-style ceil(absmax/7) row Scale32 records and exact-histogram 32-iteration Lloyd-Max tensor codebook
required_constructor.assignment: nearest reconstructed row_scale*codepoint/16; lower index wins exact ties
required_constructor.row_scale_update: exact dyadic least-squares ideal constrained by absmax*16/127 and legal Scale32 range; evaluate bracketing legal records, immediate significand neighbors, and prior record; minimize source-space SSE with frozen tie rules
required_constructor.codebook_update: exact per-cluster quadratic costs over all 256 signed-Q4.4 values plus dynamic programming for the globally minimum-cost strictly increasing 16-entry codebook; empty clusters retain prior values; lexicographically smaller codebook wins cost ties
required_constructor.monotonicity: source-space tensor SSE may not increase across any outer iteration
required_constructor.determinism: independent candidate A and B payload, row-scale, codebook, reconstruction, iteration-trace, and state manifests must match byte-for-byte

model_and_alias_policy.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model_and_alias_policy.split_operation: clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before construction and set only in-memory tie_word_embeddings false
model_and_alias_policy.embedding_preservation: original embedding object, storage, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged
model_and_alias_policy.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linears plus separated lm_head

storage_and_accelerator_contract.weight_payload: one unsigned 4-bit codebook index per weight
storage_and_accelerator_contract.row_scale: one existing 32-bit Scale32 record per output row; zero additional bytes
storage_and_accelerator_contract.codebook: one aligned 16-byte signed-Q4.4 record per Linear tensor

required_before_marker: candidate A and B state, payload, row-scale, codebook, reconstruction, and iteration-trace manifests
constructor tests for Scale32 bracketing/neighbors/ties/range/all-zero rows and strict-codebook DP optimum/empty clusters/ties/range/packing/hash rejection
model-only report with 169/169 BF16 SSE non-regression against V3 and strict aggregate improvement below 2987.0298056936317
the same eight non-evaluator inputs at 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching response-gate outcomes
fresh-candidate Dynamic Scale32 report with all 312 layer/event names, legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, and no reserved -128 payload
predeclared contract binding every source, model, matrix, runner, tool version, format, and policy hash
PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json
pre_attempt_artifact_set.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer independently verifies task/hash closure, source-tied then runtime-split lm_head behavior, preserved embedding bytes, deterministic eight-iteration joint row-Scale32/codebook construction within 4.036 bits per weight, strict V3-relative model-only improvement, 8/8 preflight exactness, legal 312-event Dynamic Scale32 execution, and—only if the official marker exists—9/9 exact BF16 token arrays plus 9/9 matching response-gate outcomes.
prohibited_work: modify, resume, replay, reinterpret, or officially execute V3 or any consumed predecessor
create the V4 execution marker during planning, runner development, construction, or preflight
use official nine-prompt inputs, outputs, token arrays, or response gates for construction or preflight
add per-group or per-scalar weight metadata, sparse exceptions, wider payloads, extra row records, or more than one codebook per Linear tensor
modify RTL, testbenches, formal properties, synthesis constraints, certified PPA evidence, or the sealed two-token record
retarget or claim the arbitrary-text demo
begin U280 integration, emulation, bitstream, or board work
